description: Find issues by what they are ABOUT, in plain words — by meaning as well as by words (where the server has its embedding model), so an issue that says the same thing differently or in another language is found, which search_issues (JQL) cannot do. The same search answers with `pages` (wiki pages) and `files` (PDF and Word files attached to an issue or a page, found by the words inside them): "everything on this counterparty" finds the contract and not only the issue that names it. Best first; `match` says what found each (words, meaning, or only near words — the weakest). `unread_files` lists the files this search could NOT read (a scan, a damaged or protected file, an old .doc): nothing found says nothing about those. Use search_issues for questions about fields (mine, overdue, in status X).

limit.description: How many of each kind to return (default 10, max 25).

projectKey.description: Only this project (must be visible to the token). Omit for every project the token sees.

text.description: What it is about, in your own words.

name: find_issues
title: Find issues
